import sys, random, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import planner, verify
from stress import build
from probability import window_thresholds
import numpy as np
rng = random.Random(4711)
# max times, all windows eligible everywhere, tight resources
c = build(rng, 512, 256, 32, 16, 1, 1, True)
# push slot times to the 1e12 range
base = 10**12 - 512*3
t = base
for i,s in enumerate(c['slots']):
    s[0] = t; t += 3
for w in c['windows']:
    w[1] = 0; w[2] = c['slots'][-1][0]
print('W =', 1+len(c['windows'])*c['slots'][-1][0])
n=len(c['windows'])
t0=time.time(); res=planner.solve_epoch(c); el=time.time()-t0
feats=np.array([w[7] for w in c['windows']],dtype=np.int64).reshape(n,9,2)
preds=__import__('testcnnonnx' if c['model']=='cnn' else 'testrnnonnx').evaluate_model_single_pass(feats,np.zeros(n,dtype=np.int64))
th=window_thresholds(c['stats'],c['windows'])
values=[c['windows'][j][6]*c['class_values'][preds[j]] for j in range(n)]
errs=verify.verify(c,res,th,values)
print('time %.2f'%(el), res['ratio'], 'served', sum(1 for a in res['assignment'] if a>=0), 'maxpot', max(abs(x) for x in res['potential']), 'errs', errs[:2])
print('peakMB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)
